userDecision: В последнем фото получился довольно симпатичный дизайн тренажера, можем ли мы его зафиксировать, мне кажется что он более приятный для нашего дизайна.
scope: Equipment materials, palette, surface finish and studio rendering direction for new or explicitly revised exercise illustrations.

visualLanguage.frame: Satin silver-gray metal with smooth, restrained highlights and clean joins.
visualLanguage.enclosures: Deep graphite or near-black weight-stack covers, with calm continuous surfaces and softly rounded transitions supported by the real machine.
visualLanguage.upholsteryAndGrips: Dark matte padding, rubber grips and feet; fine consistent material texture.
visualLanguage.accents: Small functional controls remain legible and restrained; equipment stays visually subordinate to the movement.
visualLanguage.rendering: Premium semi-realistic 3D on a clean white studio background, soft neutral light and natural contact shadows.
visualLanguage.cardPresentation: Full athlete and apparatus, coherent body-to-machine proportions, comparable scale and stable fixed equipment across START/FINISH in the existing square contain frame.

referenceAuthority.equipmentGeometry: Verified real-machine references for the exact exercise/configuration, preserving functional dimensions, support, mechanisms, handles and contact clearances.
referenceAuthority.maleIdentityAndOutfit: Actual externally supplied CRESUM Male Master; this exercise frame is an additional equipment-style reference.
referenceAuthority.phaseContinuity: The selected START frame grounds FINISH camera, equipment, proportions and material continuity.

productionUse: Supply reference.webp alongside the actual character Master and exact equipment/phase references in future generation calls. Compare full frames and phone-size START/FINISH before presenting candidates. This is a human production reference; no automatic Prompt Package or runtime resolver binding is added.
reviewScope: User preference approves the equipment visual language. Source assisted-pull-up pair remains user-selected-provisional for its detailed anatomy/biomechanics, concealed counterweight mechanics and physical-device acceptance.
sourceRetention: Exact WebP reference is committed independently of the exercise asset path. Original PNG and generation/reference chain retain their existing provenance; source PC ZIP checkpoint and Oracle upload remain separate.
